objective: Compare current/auto against explicit CUDA Graph measurement with default-candidate comparison in both arms; independently evaluate each naturally selected winner against default on the same real SGLang FP8 linear serving graph.

flashinfer_source.implementation: Exact original diff applied cleanly to0.7.2, not full PR head; candidate source only for every arm.
flashinfer_source.native_loading: Reuse audited prepare_native(candidate): explicit JitSpec.build/load, identical module bootstrap in every arm; reject AOT substitution. One isolated candidate build workspace, fresh process/container per worker.

environment.hardware_change: Request the same H100 NVL physical GPU; require identical UUID, driver and power limit before workers. Any necessary hardware substitution requires an explicitly recorded protocol revision before measurements. Comparisons are within this batch.

workload.projection: First transformer layer fused q/k/v projection, concatenated in source-verified SGLang QKV loader order.
workload.fixture: Frozen captured BF16 activations and checkpoint weights; per-tensor static scales calibrated from this one input/weight tensor. Exact shapes, tensor/file hashes and capture provenance frozen before tuning workers.

measurement_policy.auto: Unspecified measurement_policy through the existing v2 startup context; this FP8 path uses eager/hot-L2 timing.
measurement_policy.cuda_graph: MeasurementPolicy(execution_mode="cuda_graph") only; no L2, replay-count, warmup or repeat overrides.

workload.persistence: Winner consumption is memory-only inside matching replay scopes at capture. Existing wrapper may emit incidental v1 JSON, but workers never reload it and no explicit-policy persistence claim is made. Managed persistence disabled in both arms.
workload.shape_limit: One representative captured prefill projection, not full-model output accuracy or traffic distribution. Dense BF16 checkpoint adapted to static per-tensor FP8 for this experiment; no production calibration claim.
workload.path: Actual SGLang static quantizer, normal custom-op dispatch/fast path and allocation, FlashInfer cublas FP8 implementation; no replacement or output copy in timed calls.
workload.profiling_input_limit: Actual startup and serving calls use the frozen captured activations, real QKV weights and static FP8 scales. The tuner retains synthesized dynamic profiling activations. Record A/B/scale fingerprints for every profile; compare them across arms and trials. Output/workspace bytes are not representative input fingerprints.

protocol.trial_order: Ascending0..5, balanced arm order; fresh process/container/private empty cache per worker; no adaptive stopping based on performance.

graphs.winner: Independent serving graph captured after tuning under the matching memory-only replay scope; must consume a real cache hit on the natural winner.
graphs.default: Independent serving graph captured after tuning under a genuine cache miss with reversible cache-state removal; must use heuristic tactic-1.

protocol.capture_order: winner/default for even trial IDs, reverse for odd IDs.
protocol.profiling_change: Only execution_mode is overridden; preserve the pinned profiler defaults and record policy-derived timer behavior. Both arms enable the default-candidate race. No new margin, confirmation policy, representative-input override, shortlist implementation, or dependency update.
protocol.block_order: 12 winner/default and12 default/winner blocks, deterministic shuffled seed5000+trial; identical5120replays per graph in every block.
protocol.timing: Replay retained graphs after exiting all policy/tuning contexts. Primary CUDA-event span plus wall-time channel. No Python lookup/output rebinding/native probe/torch profiler/subprocess query inside timed spans. Event spans can include host submission gaps.
protocol.numerical_guards: Actual graph-owned output, quantized-input FP32 reference, poison checks, zero/restored captured inputs, separate BF16 approximation diagnostics.
protocol.profiling_observation: Common instrumentation around the real profiler records effective configuration and A/B/scale hashes outside timed candidate execution; retain its overhead caveat. No controlled profiling times or forced winner.
protocol.checkpoint: First trial pair must pass correctness/provenance/selection gates before remaining10workers. No performance acceptance threshold.
protocol.startup_scope: Record instrumented wrapper-only startup cost separately; runtime winner quality is the primary outcome.

acceptance: Frozen source, actual source-overlay/nativebuild, exact fixture bytes, expected GPU/image/driver/powerlimit and production helper hashes verified.
Both arms use real v2 candidate selection/default race; profile candidates, A/B/scales, buckets and non-objective settings match.
Every measured candidate time finite; natural runtime winner is a measured minimum; default participates without being forced to win.
Winner capture consumes real matching memory hit; default capture consumes genuine miss/tactic-1; cache maps/state restored.
All retained serving graphs pass numerical/poison/changed-input guards; zero profiling during capture and replay.
Policy scopes exited and tuning/store/stream state restored before replay. Incidental v1files never provide explicit-policy winner evidence.
Balanced common-replay blocks and independent fresh trial identifiers preserved; retain every failed attempt and rerun reason.

analysis.independent_unit: Six fresh tuning processes/trials per arm. The24 blocks and15 samples are dependent within-trial subsamples.
analysis.primary: Pertrial median within-block winner/default GPU-event ratio; report all six values, median/range, below1counts and exploratory exact wholetrial-bootstrap95percent interval.
analysis.objective_comparison: Pair trials across arms and report ratio of normalized winner/default scores (cuda_graph/auto). Retain raw absolute latency summaries; do not claim crossprocess physicalidentity or fullmodel serving gains.
analysis.uncertainty: Wholetrial bootstrap only; small fixed-workload sample, descriptive/exploratory intervals and mixed/neutral/regressive outcomes retained.
analysis.secondary: Wall timing, actual chosen tactics, profile margins, instrumented tuning walltime, effective profiler settings and clock/power context.
analysis.scope_limits: One H100 NVL, one frozen statically calibrated FP8 QKV fixture, pinned0.7.2 plus original descriptor diff. No fullmodel accuracy/throughput, freshprocess graph persistence, TP/EP or MegaMoE qualification. No new native observer campaign; existing capture-time descriptor acceptance checks still apply.

publication.private_material: Fixture tensors, native binaries and internal host details remain in private raw archive; public evidence keeps allowed hashes/metadata and filtered raw logs.

resource_policy: One exclusive allocation on the same physical H100, bounded to one hour including source preparation. Freeze source before measurements. Preserve the full private binary/fixture archive with node/durable/download hash agreement before release. No CI trigger or PR.

prior_observation.cause: unresolved; v2/v1 graph ratio was lower, so this is not proof of v2 versus v1 regression.
